title: Sage sky record
description: A sky record (SkyRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another sky record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

sunrise.description: When the sun rises (it is on the eastern horizon) Unit: h. Range: 0 to 24. Category: Sun. (float, default 6)

sunset.description: When the sun sets. Unit: h. Range: 0 to 24. Category: Sun. (float, default 18)

lean.description: How far the sun's path leans toward the south (z), 0 is straight overhead. Category: Sun. (float, default 0.3)

keys.description: The keyframes, by hour; any order, any number. One is a sky that never changes. (List<SkyKey>)

hour.description: The hour of day this key is at. Unit: h. Range: 0 to 24. (float)

sun.description: The sun's colour at full height; it fades to nothing at the horizon. (Vector3)

horizon.description: The sky at the horizon; also the clear colour. (Vector3)

fog.description: The colour things fade into with distance. (Vector3)

fogStart.description: Where fog begins. Unit: m. At least 0. (float)

fogEnd.description: Where fog is complete. Unit: m. At least 0. (float)

shadow.description: How dark shadows are (0: none, 1: full); the sun's own height fades it too. Range: 0 to 1. (float)

keys+.description: Adds to "keys": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

hour.description: The hour of day this key is at. Unit: h. Range: 0 to 24. (float)

sun.description: The sun's colour at full height; it fades to nothing at the horizon. (Vector3)

horizon.description: The sky at the horizon; also the clear colour. (Vector3)

fog.description: The colour things fade into with distance. (Vector3)

fogStart.description: Where fog begins. Unit: m. At least 0. (float)

fogEnd.description: Where fog is complete. Unit: m. At least 0. (float)

shadow.description: How dark shadows are (0: none, 1: full); the sun's own height fades it too. Range: 0 to 1. (float)

keys-.description: Removes these from "keys" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

hour.description: The hour of day this key is at. Unit: h. Range: 0 to 24. (float)

sun.description: The sun's colour at full height; it fades to nothing at the horizon. (Vector3)

horizon.description: The sky at the horizon; also the clear colour. (Vector3)

fog.description: The colour things fade into with distance. (Vector3)

fogStart.description: Where fog begins. Unit: m. At least 0. (float)

fogEnd.description: Where fog is complete. Unit: m. At least 0. (float)

shadow.description: How dark shadows are (0: none, 1: full); the sun's own height fades it too. Range: 0 to 1. (float)
